# FPA Design Consultancy

> Licensed architectural firm in Baguio City, Benguet, Philippines, founded and led by Arch. Friendzel B. Pengi, UAP, a PRC-licensed architect. We design houses, commercial buildings and interiors, prepare signed and sealed building permit plans, and supervise construction across Northern Luzon. We also work with OFWs and other Filipinos abroad, remotely.

## What we do
- Architectural design: houses, apartments and commercial buildings: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/architectural-design
- Building permit documentation, signed and sealed by a PRC-licensed architect: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/building-permit-documentation
- Interior design: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/interior-design
- Renovation and remodeling: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/renovation-remodeling
- Space planning: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/space-planning
- Cabinet design: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/cabinet-design
- 3D visualization and rendering: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/3d-visualization-rendering
- Construction supervision: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/construction-supervision
- Construction project management: https://www.fp-architect.com/services/construction-project-management

## Where we work
- Office in Baguio City, Benguet.
- Projects across Northern Luzon: Baguio City and Benguet, La Union, Ifugao, Nueva Vizcaya and Ilocos Sur. Location pages: https://www.fp-architect.com/locations
- Remote design for OFWs and Filipinos abroad, by video call and digital file exchange: https://www.fp-architect.com/build-from-abroad

## Working with us
- The first consultation is free. After it you receive an itemized, project-specific quotation, with no obligation to go ahead.
- Architect fees follow the Standards of Professional Practice (SPP) under the Architecture Act (RA 9266). They typically range from 8–12% of total construction cost for full design and supervision services, which is about ₱3,200–₱4,800 per square meter for a standard-finish house: https://www.fp-architect.com/guides/architect-fees-philippines
- Office hours: daily, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Philippine time). Office visits are by appointment only. Messages are welcome any time.
- Payment: cash, GCash or bank transfer.
- Parking is available at the office.

## The architect
Arch. Friendzel B. Pengi, UAP: licensed architect (Professional Regulation Commission), Safety Officer 2 (DOLE), BS Architecture from Lyceum Northwestern University, member of the United Architects of the Philippines. Speaks English, Filipino and Ilocano. https://www.fp-architect.com/about
